title: Full-Scale Commerce Platform
objective: Build a production-oriented multi-page commerce frontend and integrate with a backend API.
scenario: Build a production-oriented multi-page commerce frontend and integrate with a backend API. Build in increments, keep a written acceptance checklist, and verify one failure or boundary case per major workflow.
